=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- File: scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh
  Line or code reference: 855-865 (the `if [ "${1:-}" = "validate" ]; then main_validate "$@" ; else stage_review_runtime_support ; fi` dispatch at EOF) + 1-346 (stage_review_runtime_support)
  Problem: The new `stage_review_runtime_support` implementation (the contract baseline for review_autofix support staging) is unreachable. The workflow calls the helper with no arguments, so the legacy `main_validate` path is taken instead. The helper now contains two parallel, slightly-diverged copies of the staging logic.
  Why it fails at runtime: review_autofix.yml's "Stage workflow support files" step (and therefore all downstream preflight, reviewer, editor, and validation steps) continues to use the old inline logic or an incomplete helper path; the shared-helper migration required by issue #3201 never actually activates. This breaks the Semble contract, test assertions, and the "single source of truth" goal.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- File: scripts/check_workflow_script_refs.py
  Line or code reference: 122-130 (EXTRA_REF_HOLDER_FILES handling + call to check_paths on the helper itself)
  Problem: The checker now walks `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh` (which itself declares and expands the exact same REQUIRED/OPTIONAL/MAIN_PRIMARY lists). This creates a circular self-reference in the reference graph.
  Why it fails at runtime: Future workflow changes can produce spurious "script does not exist" or duplicate-ref warnings from the CI lint step, and the EXTRA_REF_HOLDER_FILES mechanism can mask real missing-script errors introduced by other callers.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

- File: scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh
  Line or code reference: 12-16 (early RUNNER_TEMP/GITHUB_* guard) + 18-19 (unvalidated CURRENT_REPOSITORY / WORKFLOW_SOURCE_REPO / workspace_root)
  Problem: The guard only aborts for a subset of required runner variables. The function later uses CURRENT_REPOSITORY, WORKFLOW_SOURCE_REPO (injected by the workflow), and workspace_root unconditionally.
  Why it fails at runtime: Non-GitHub-Actions callers (test harnesses, manual runs, the "validate" sub-path) can hit unbound-variable errors under `set -u` or stage from the wrong tree. The legacy main_validate path has no equivalent guard.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

- File: scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh
  Line or code reference: 37-38 (REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS) + 44-45 (OPTIONAL_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS) + 855 (dispatch)
  Problem: `review_collect_pr_metadata.sh` was omitted from the helper's REQUIRED list in an earlier edit (visible in last_run_diff) yet the workflow still calls `${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR}/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh` after staging. The helper's top-level dispatch also preserves two slightly-diverged copies of the same lists.
  Why it fails at runtime: On consumer runs the metadata collection step will fail with "No such file" unless the helper happens to fall back to the old inline path (which the migration was supposed to remove). Violates the "preserve existing behavior" and "single source of truth" contracts.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: 1273-1279 (the new helper invocation) + 2794-2800 (updated preflight)
  Problem: The workflow now delegates to the helper but the preflight still contains a stale `check_soft_file` for render_prompt.py that was tuned in a prior autofix pass; more importantly, it no longer asserts that all expected SUPPORT_* vars were exported by the helper.
  Why it fails at runtime: A broken helper (as shown above) can leave the environment in an inconsistent state with no early detection. The preflight is now weaker than the original inline version.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

- Requirement: "Introduce `scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh` as the shared owner for support-file staging, using the current review_autofix behavior as the contract baseline. Migrate `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` to call the helper from the checked-out workflow-source snapshot instead of carrying the inline bootstrap block. Preserve out-of-tree staging, existing SUPPORT_* env var names, main-primary bootstrap preference, optional render_prompt.py semantics, and the current required/optional script lists."
  Expected change site: scripts/stage_workflow_support.sh (must be the single source of truth) + .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (must delegate unconditionally and remove the ~300-line inline block) + all contract tests.
  Evidence of absence: The helper contains two parallel implementations and an unreachable `stage_review_runtime_support` path; the workflow call does not exercise the new code; REQUIRED_BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPTS in the helper is missing review_collect_pr_metadata.sh while the workflow still invokes it; tests assert contracts that the on-disk helper + workflow no longer satisfy.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- Requirement: "Add the helper's registry entry to `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` using the existing format." (and per unattended_system_instructions.md §20, any new long-running script must be wired into an automatic scheduler path in the same PR)
  Expected change site: docs/scripts-pending-removal.md + an existing scheduler / workflow that runs it automatically (no new standalone manual script allowed).
  Evidence of absence: The registry entry exists but marks the helper "long-running" and gives a "permanent — review annually" trigger without citing any scheduler/wiring file. No update to any cron, PR-push, or workflow entry point was made. This violates the §20 plan-output and implementation rules that the orchestrator enforces.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
